Emperor: The God-Emperor of Mankind is the immortal ruler of the Imperium, seated upon the Golden Throne. His psychic presence guides humanity across the galaxy.
Space Marines: Genetically enhanced super-soldiers created to defend humanity. They are organized into Chapters and are among the most powerful warriors in the Imperium.
Primarchs: The Primarchs are the twenty superhuman sons of the Emperor, each created to lead the Space Marine Legions. Many are lost, corrupted, or missing.
Chaos: The ruinous powers of the Warp: Khorne, Tzeentch, Nurgle, and Slaanesh. They feed on emotion and seek to corrupt all life.
Khorne: The Chaos God of blood, war, and skulls. Khorne cares not from where the blood flows, only that it does.
Tzeentch: The Chaos God of change, manipulation, and sorcery. Master of schemes and destiny.
Nurgle: The Chaos God of decay, disease, and rebirth. Followers embrace rot as a form of twisted life.
Slaanesh: The Chaos God of excess, pleasure, and perfection. Born from the fall of the Eldar.
Orks: A brutal and war-loving xenos species that thrives on battle. Their belief can shape reality through psychic energy.
WAAAGH: A massive Ork war campaign fueled by collective psychic energy, making Orks stronger as their numbers grow.
Eldar: An ancient and highly advanced alien race with powerful psychic abilities. They walk a strict path to avoid falling into Chaos.
Dark Eldar: A cruel faction of Eldar that feed on pain and suffering to sustain themselves.
Necrons: Ancient robotic beings who once traded their souls for immortality. They are awakening after millions of years of dormancy.
Tyranids: An extragalactic hive mind species that consumes all biological matter. They adapt rapidly and are nearly unstoppable.
Imperium: The vast human empire spanning the galaxy, ruled by the Emperor. It is a brutal and authoritarian regime.
Inquisition: A secretive organization tasked with rooting out heresy, xenos, and Chaos corruption within the Imperium.
Adeptus Mechanicus: The tech-priests of Mars who worship the Machine God and maintain ancient technology.
Warp: A parallel dimension of pure psychic energy used for faster-than-light travel, but filled with daemons and Chaos entities.
Golden Throne: A life-sustaining device that keeps the Emperor alive. It also powers the Astronomican, guiding ships through the Warp.
Astronomican: A psychic beacon generated by the Emperor that allows navigation through the Warp.
